title: November Examination
instructions: This paper consists of FOUR questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Round off answers to TWO decimal places, unless stated otherwise.
Units of measurement must be shown in final answers. The tax table used is illustrative.

context.caption: ILLUSTRATIVE tax table
rows: R43 200 + 26% of taxable income above R240 000
R78 300 + 31% of taxable income above R375 000

questions.prompt: Thandeka's monthly taxable income is R26 000. Calculate her annual taxable income.
Calculate Thandeka's annual income tax payable.
Calculate her monthly PAYE (two decimals).
R12 000 is invested at 9% p.a. compound interest. Calculate its value after 3 years.
A washing machine costs R8 400 cash or R840 deposit plus 24 instalments of R420 on hire purchase. How much more does HP cost?
questions.memo:
✓ Instalments 24 × R420 = R10 080 (1)
✓ Total HP R10 920 (1)
✓ Extra R2 520 (1)

questions.prompt: Inflation is 5,5% per year. A taxi fare is R22 now. What will it be in 2 years?
A salary increases from R14 200 to R15 052. Calculate the percentage increase.
Bank X charges R65 per month plus R6,00 per transaction. Bank Y charges R125 per month with unlimited transactions. For how many transactions per month are the costs equal?
A rectangular fish pond is 2,5 m long, 1,6 m wide and 0,8 m deep. Calculate its volume in litres, and how long a pump delivering 20 ℓ per minute will take to fill it.
A cylindrical rain tank has a radius of 0,75 m and height of 1,8 m. Calculate its capacity in litres. Use $\pi = 3{,}142$.
Convert 3,2 m² to cm².
Boxes measuring 20 cm × 15 cm × 10 cm are packed into a crate 80 cm × 60 cm × 50 cm (same orientation). How many boxes fit?
A road sign shows 60 miles. Convert to km (1 mile = 1,609 km), to one decimal place.

The four walls of a room are each 4 m long and 2,6 m high. One litre of paint covers 9 m². Paint is sold in 5 ℓ tins at R420. Calculate the cost of painting all four walls with one coat (ignore doors and windows).
A model house is built to a scale of 1 : 75. The model's roof is 8 cm high. How high is the real roof, in metres?
On a 1 : 50 plan, a patio measures 9 cm by 6 cm. Paving costs R265 per m². Calculate the cost of paving the patio.
A bus leaves Cape Town at 06:45 and travels 400 km to Oudtshoorn at an average speed of 80 km/h, stopping for 30 minutes. At what time does it arrive?
What is the difference between a floor plan and an elevation plan?
questions.memo:
✓ A floor plan shows the layout from above (1)
✓ An elevation shows the outside view from the front, back or side (1)

questions.prompt: A 1 : 20 scale model of a water tank holds 0,25 ℓ. How many litres does the real tank hold? Explain your method.

context.text: Number of cars sold per week by a dealership over 11 weeks: 8; 12; 5; 9; 14; 7; 10; 6; 15; 9; 11

questions.prompt: Determine the five-number summary of the data.
Calculate the interquartile range.
Calculate the mean (two decimals).
The dealer advertises 'Our sales have tripled!' by comparing week 3 (5 cars) with week 9 (15 cars). Explain why comparing only two weeks can be misleading.
questions.memo:
✓ Two weeks are a very small sample (1)
✓ Sales vary a lot from week to week, so a fair comparison should use averages over many weeks (1)

questions.prompt: A game costs R10 to play. You spin a spinner with 8 equal sections; landing on the single gold section wins R50. Over 80 games, how much do you expect to win or lose?
questions.memo:
✓ P(gold) = $\frac{1}{8}$ (1)
✓ Expected wins: 10 × R50 = R500 (1)
✓ Cost: 80 × R10 = R800 (1)
✓ Expected loss R300 (1)

questions.prompt: Why does a survey of only 20 customers at one branch give an unreliable picture of customer satisfaction for a national chain?
questions.memo:
✓ The sample is too small (1)
✓ and not representative of all branches/customers (1)

questions.prompt: Of 200 learners, 120 passed Maths Literacy and 90 of those also passed English; 60 learners passed English but failed Maths Literacy. If a learner who passed English is chosen at random, what is the probability that they also passed Maths Literacy?
